limits: Observed timings include all-stop observer overhead; not startup/performance results
A clean observer-thread shutdown does not imply the workload schedule completed
Event maxima in an incomplete schedule are not full-workload peaks
Stack write-attempt4KiB bounds are not exact stack or RSP high-water marks
Mapped ELF-plus-user-stack backing is not RSS, residency, quota or whole-cell memory
Draw/flush entry counts are attempts/calls, not redraw cost or framebuffer changes
Hidden exit-request origin and historical failure causality remain unproven

GUI_input_admission.exercise_ceiling: Actual input journal present; individual checks retain their stated scope
limits: Commit is emulator acceptance, not guest consumption or full-workload completion
Request is journaled before write; a failed/short write may have ambiguous delivery and never permits resend
Batch identities/order are separate even when two original batches contain identical keys
Known late acceptance can coexist with terminal caller timeout; commit_count must not be erased

QMP_transaction_audit.scope: Audit of recorded observer QMP request/returns; GUI shares the same installed full-transaction mutex. This does not invent raw GUI reply logging.

RSP_atomic_receive_audit.scope: One pending-frame record per validated frame; packet_rx after successful ACK. ACK-attempt log precedes send and alone never proves delivery.
